verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents built-in AI that takes over specific work. The AI Receptionist answers and routes calls, and the vendor describes an 'Agentic Voice AI platform to automate, assist, and analyze customer interactions.' That amounts to delegating call handling to a native AI agent, but only for a narrow, customer-facing task rather than a general assistant a user can hand tasks to. The ChatGPT/Claude connectors and MCP servers rely on external LLMs, so they earn no credit here. The human 'call delegation' feature is also unrelated. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-app assistant that accepts user-initiated tasks, documentation of how users instruct or delegate to it, the range of task types it can execute, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
